name: Family Fun Candy Cane Crawl at the Manitowoc-Two Rivers YMCA
when_note: Saturday, December 5, 2026, 2 to 4 PM; swimming with Santa 3 to 4 PM
cost: $10 per family for YMCA members; $20 per family for nonmembers
paras: The Manitowoc-Two Rivers YMCA hosts its Family Fun Candy Cane Crawl on Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 2 to 4 PM at 205 Maritime Dr. in Manitowoc.

Families try gymnastics and festive activities, decorate holiday cookies, warm up at a cocoa bar and take photos with Santa. Santa also goes swimming with the kids from 3 to 4 PM. The cost is $10 per family for YMCA members and $20 per family for nonmembers.
tip: Pack swim gear for the 3 PM swim with Santa.

name: Living Windows in Downtown Two Rivers
when_note: Saturday, November 28, 3 to 5:30 PM, and Saturday, December 12, 11 AM to 1 PM, 2026
paras: Living Windows turns the storefront windows of downtown Two Rivers into Christmas scenes with live actors and music. It runs on Saturday, November 28, 2026, from 3 to 5:30 PM before the Lakeshore Holiday Parade, and again on Saturday, December 12, from 11 AM to 1 PM during Cool City Christmas.
Families stroll downtown to watch each window come to life, and the fun is free for all ages.
tip: Bundle up for the walk between windows.

name: Cool City Christmas in Downtown Two Rivers
address: The Washington House, 1622 Jefferson St., Two Rivers, WI 54241
paras: The fourth annual Cool City Christmas fills downtown Two Rivers on Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 10 AM to 2 PM, with stops at the Community House, Central Park and The Washington House.
Most events are free, and the Living Windows storefront scenes run from 11 AM to 1 PM the same day, so families can see both in one outing.
tip: Pair it with the Living Windows scenes at 11 AM.
